description: Effective GeoIP settings: the active provider (DB-IP Lite or MaxMind GeoLite2) and its databases (the license key is never returned)

account_id.description: The MaxMind account ID the databases are downloaded with; empty when not set

editions.description: The MaxMind GeoLite2 databases to download: Country, ASN and City (used while the provider is maxmind)

provider.description: The active provider. GEOIP_PROVIDER wins and locks the field; else the saved choice; else maxmind when a MaxMind account ID and license key are set; else dbip

dbip_editions.description: The DB-IP Lite databases to download: Country and ASN (used while the provider is dbip)

license_key_set.description: Whether a license key is saved or set by the environment. The key itself is never returned

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: The environment variable that sets each locked field (name only, never the value)

secret_error.description: Whether the saved license key cannot be decrypted and must be entered again

last_update.description: When the databases were last updated (ISO 8601 in UTC), null before the first update

last_check.description: When the last update run finished, successful or not (ISO 8601 in UTC), null before the first run. The DB-IP weekly schedule keys on it

last_error.description: The error of the last update, null after a success
